ownership: All retries and branches are HIA. FS7 issues tokens and performs raw syscalls through the fixed mechanical carrier.
The full path is raw non-NUL bytes; empty path reaches actual openat via new raw operation28 rather than a fabricated ENOENT. Original1..27 behavior is retained by separate source revision.
A fresh one-shot robust context is issued by one trusted serial coordinator; this draft does not add an OS process or an arbitrary child capability.
Source/ACK bytes are private immutable issued leases, not external authentication. Nonce/call/action/header consistency alone cannot authenticate a foreign buffer.
FS context and temporary refill descriptors belong to the shared namespace process. A successful /dev/null refill token is not returned or prematurely closed by this owner.

The warning callback happens after the low descriptor CLOSE and before /dev/null OPEN. HIA renders the full original warning bytes; a typed warning ACK reports the callback errno. Ordinary no-callback logger leaves errno unchanged.
